# <span id="aanchor33"></span> Ticket Validation Templates

Validation templates are used to configure validations for tickets. Once created, these templates can be attached to a location and used to validate all tickets within that location. The validations that are available to run differ for each ticket type.

## Validation Process

Once a validation template has been added to Ticket Validations in the Location Editor then the tickets that are under that location will be validated. The validation process will run when under the following conditions:

- A ticket is imported into FLOWCAL and is assigned to a location that has validation templates assigned to it.
- A ticket is manually created and is assigned to a location that has validation templates assigned to it.
- A ticket is edited that is assigned to a location with validation templates.
- A change is made in the Ticket Validation window.

If multiple validation templates are attached to a single location the order of the validations will be determined by the order in which they are listed in the [Ticket Validations](../../Locations/Location%20Editor/Tools%20-%20Ticket%20Validations.md) window.

Validation templates that have a product specified will only be run against tickets that contain that same product. If there is no product specified, the template will be run against all tickets with a matching ticket type.

In this example, the meter ticket that contains crude oil will be validated by the Meter Ticket template and the Meter Ticket – Crude Oil template. The order these validations are run in is determined by the order in which the templates appear in the [Ticket Validations](../../Locations/Location%20Editor/Tools%20-%20Ticket%20Validations.md) window. If an incoming ticket does not meet the criteria of the validation templates that are attached to the location, no validations will be run for that ticket.
